    Residual diagnostic plots for a random-parameter bivariate NB model

    plot.rpbnb_fit.Rd

    Four base-graphics panels per margin, as for plot.bnb_fit(), built on the mixture-based randomized quantile residuals. resid_type = "deviance" is not available for rpbnb_fit.

    Usage

    # S3 method for class 'rpbnb_fit'
plot(
  x,
  margin = c("both", "y1", "y2"),
  which = 1:4,
  resid_type = "quantile",
  seed = NULL,
  ...
)

    Arguments

    x

    An rpbnb_fit object from fit_rpbnb().

    margin

    Which margin to plot: "both" (default), "y1", or "y2".

    which

    Integer subset of panels 1:4.

    resid_type

    Residual type for panels 1 and 4: "quantile" (default), "pearson", or "response".

    seed

    Optional integer seed for the RQR randomization.

    ...

    Unused.

    Value

    NULL, invisibly.
